scope: Exploratory full-size public encoder comparison in Node Wasm. Four deterministic public inputs, repeated twice. The digest is the first eight bytes of SHA-256 over the complete encoded vector. This is bounded differential evidence, not a security proof or hosted measurement.

original.scope: Public ExConv full-sized encoding in Node Wasm. Synthetic public inputs, SHA-256 prefix over the full output. Includes input fill and hashing. No network or Workers attribution.
